card.name: Promotional calls to action
card.fires_on: Words inside upbeat web calls to action or sign-up invitations, such as "Be the first one to follow" or "you just need to". It sits where an exclamation mark could soon end the sentence.

modes.label: Invitation phrases
modes.description: Words inside encouraging prompts to join, follow, or sign up.
modes.example: Be the first<< one>> to follow.

modes.description: Words in advertising or contest text promising ease or a reward.

card.writes: It promotes exclamation marks, so the model tends to end such promotional sentences with an exclamation point.
card.plain: It notices cheerful marketing or sign-up wording where a sentence is likely to finish with an exclamation mark.
